item.description: It's hard to come up with a plot twist the audience doesn't see coming. item.description: Not every classic begins as a success story. Some films open to little or no acclaim, and that's just the biz. At the time, they’re labeled disappointments or outright failures. But when the dust settles, home video gives them a second life, and magic happens years later. These are the films that lost the box office battle but ultimately won the cultural war.
